title: Web application
description: Authenticated product UI with data, forms and a backend.

steps.title: Brief
steps.acceptance: User stories, data model sketch, roles/permissions, out-of-scope list and repo are in the brief.

steps.title: UX spec
steps.acceptance: Screens and states (empty, loading, error, success) at 1440 and 390; component list reusing the existing design system.

steps.title: Build
steps.acceptance: Feature implemented with typed API boundaries, migrations, and tests for business logic.

steps.title: Code review
steps.acceptance: Diff within scope; input validated at boundaries; no `any`; migrations reversible.

steps.title: Security gate
steps.acceptance: Every item of SECURITY RULES checked and reported pass/fail with file references.

steps.title: Visual gate
steps.acceptance: Screenshots at 1440 and 390 score >= 8/10; all four states exist.

steps.title: QA
steps.acceptance: Playwright flow covers the main user story plus one failure path; no console errors.

security_rules: No secrets, tokens or `.env` content in code, commits, logs or screenshots.
Dependencies: pin versions, run the audit (`npm audit --omit=dev`), no new package without a stated reason.
Authentication on every route and server action; authorisation checked per resource (no IDOR).
Sessions: httpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies; CSRF protection for state-changing requests.
All input validated server-side with a schema (e.g. zod); output encoded; no raw SQL string building.
Passwords hashed with scrypt/argon2; no custom crypto.
File upload: type and size limits, random file names, stored outside the web root.
Rate limit login and public endpoints; generic error messages (no stack traces to the client).
Secrets only from environment; nothing sensitive in client bundles or logs.
tech_stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Actions) + TypeScript strict
Postgres + Drizzle ORM with versioned migrations
GSAP/Lenis only for polish, never required for function
